title: AbdomenAtlas: A Large-Scale, Detailed-Annotated, & Multi-Center Dataset for Efficient Transfer Learning and Open Algorithmic Benchmarking
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical creation and benchmarking of a large-scale 3D medical image segmentation dataset (AbdomenAtlas) and its related foundation models (SuPreM). It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
